title: Sounds in focus
text: My students did an art project with old things. ...
How do you use old things? Share an example with your partner.
1 Listen to the sentences from the story and read.
2 Listen to the rhyme and chant along. Then find more words.
Don't burn rubbish. Don't throw it away.
Don't hurt Mother Earth in any way.
Recycle things for me and you.
